option.value:
# Native FFT (whisperfft)
This folder builds the `whisperfft` JNI library used by `NativeFft` to speed up mel spectrogram generation for Whisper STT.
Implementation details: - Bluestein FFT to handle non power-of-two size `400`. - Power spectrum folded to `n_fft/2 + 1` bins to match Whisper filters. - Multi-threaded frame processing (one worker per requested thread).
